page_title: MAL 0-0 BIL | Mallorca v Athletic Bilbao 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+2' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Unai Simon!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The corner finds Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post.
89' The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
88' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao will take a free kick.
86' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Mallorca for a penalty. Play continues.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder leaves the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Inaki Williams trots off the pitch and is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
78' Here is a change. Mikel Vesga is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Nico Williams.
77' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

77' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Mallorca are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
74' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
74' Mallorca will take a corner kick.
72' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
72' Poor challenge! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle.
70' Siebe Van Der Heyden (Mallorca) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.
69' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
69' The substitution has been made. Jaume Costa (Mallorca) has replaced Toni Lato.
67' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Samu Costa (Mallorca). Jorge Figueroa Vazquez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.

65' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Predrag Rajkovic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
65' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
64' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
60' Here comes a substitution. Oihan Sancet is given a rest as he is replaced by Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
60' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) replacing Inigo Lekue.

59' He should have scored! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Predrag Rajkovic makes an easy save.
56' That's the end of the game for Cyle Larin, who is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
55' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
54' The linesman signals that Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
53' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
49' Mallorca have a goal ruled out for offside!
47' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mallorca are ruled offside.
44' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
40' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) but poses no threat.
38' The foul by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) was seen by Jorge Figueroa Vazquez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
35' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Good chance! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
30' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
29' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
27' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' What a huge chance for Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
24' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece.
22' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

22' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
19' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) prepares to take a corner kick.
16' A rebound falls at the feet of Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
16' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.
12' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle as Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
11' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' So close! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
8' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) heads on.
6' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Neat passing move from Mallorca in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Flag goes up against Cyle Larin (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jorge Figueroa Vazquez.
